title: Ravens vs. Bills Picks & Predictions | NFL Week 8 Best Bets
transcript_summary: The Action Network Podcast crew analyzes the marquee matchup between the Baltimore Ravens and Buffalo Bills. Analysts weigh in on Lamar Jackson's injury status, key betting trends for both quarterbacks, and first-half vs. full-game spread value.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: All right, let's get to the best game of the weekend. It's my Baltimore Ravens taking on the Buffalo Bills. The Ravens are a 3.5-point juiced underdog. We're doing this dance again. Will Lamar Jackson play? Total 51.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: I logged this on the app a couple days ago. If Lamar plays, this line will close under 3. Bills defense has been atrocious—31st in EPA per play, 30th in success rate, 26th DVOA. Meanwhile, Lamar Jackson leads in adjusted EPA per play and success rate. Lamar is 13-2 ATS as an underdog and 18-4 ATS as a dog or short favorite. I took Ravens +3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug
speaker_segments.text: Yeah, so hopefully this banger happens. But let me ask you a question...

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: The only concern I have is Lamar does his own thing and they play Thursday night against the Jags, but I was confident enough to place a large bet on +3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug
speaker_segments.text: Situationally, Bills are off a bye and Ravens are on the road for the third time in four weeks. Is there first-half line value on Ravens +2.5? Ravens are +65 scoring differential in 1H, but -70 in 2H. Also, Bills take the ball when winning the coin flip.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: Historically, Ravens defense has gotten figured out in second halves, and Huntley's limited games skewed some of those numbers. Evan, do you have any thoughts on first half or general angles?

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan
speaker_segments.text: This game has a lot of angles. 4th quarter in Bills games has been 6-0 to the OVER. Josh Allen is 5-14 ATS 1H as a favorite since the start of last season, worst among QBs. I'd personally handicap and take Buffalo, but I would wait to see line movement.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: Minter's defense is usually strong against running QBs and backs out of the backfield. If Lamar plays, Zay Flowers will exploit Bills defense over the middle. I'm taking the 3.5 points with Baltimore.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: Outro graphics and standard Action Network sports betting disclaimers.
